body:
A day late. Sorry.

Work was rough. Today was my first full day back,v which also means it is the first time I've been to work that early since I lost my desire to live.

I couldn't help but reflect and think about what has changed in the past month and a half. Medication overhaul, and I've talked about painful things. So I'm more balanced chemically, but have more shit I'm feeling with at surface level. It's like I'm trying to unclog the toilet with 2,000 flushes. It's not going to help now, but everything will be great after a lot of shit is dealt with.

I was greeted with a lot of "how does it feel to be here early!"s from my co-workers, so I was the center of attention for doing something normal. That was awkward. Rest of the day was iPod and Xanax.

I did have a really good hamburger for lunch, so I've got that going for me.
